title.zh: Perplexity接入爆红逆向工具REA：不用源码，AI就能复刻Figma等5款软件
title.en: Perplexity接入爆红逆向工具REA：不用源码，AI就能复刻Figma等5款软件

current_state.zh: Perplexity added the open-source REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) tool to its Computer agent, letting users describe a target application and have the AI analyze its behavior and rebuild a similar version, with online demos of Figma, LibreOffice Calc, Photopea, Harvey and Audacity clones plus up to 10,000 free credits through October 31.
